title: The Berne festival grows and the city takes it over
summary: The first year includes a live record made across the German border; the city soon takes over the festival, now as prominent as Nice or Newport.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: It's a straight, all clear thing. And, so that one was very successful. And, as a matter of fact, we cut a record that year; we did a little thing where

we cross the border from Switzerland into Germany and we recorded in that small town - live performance. And, that's now a record. And, so, this has gone on like that and gets bigger and bigger and, of course, we started it - the two of us and then, of course, the city took it over. Of course, the minute the city saw what was happening with all of these thousands of people coming into Bryne for this-- because there was some outdoor concerts, indoor concerts -- you know, that kind-of thing and then there was also appearance in the big concert halls and, so, now---
And, this will be the fourth year?

Yeah - well, I'm just saying that it shows you how a littlething can-- and how these festivals get started; some guy takes a chance on a smaller one and if it's successful, he adds to it - gets it to be a bigger one. Now, the Berne Festival is just as prominent as any - as just as prominent as Nice or the Newport Festival here. Everybody knows it's going to be at a certain time every year and they just pile in there - you won't believe it. So,---
